officialVerification.policy: Selected records were fetched from their current official YC company profile and required exact slug match, ycdc_status Active, country US, a mapped Bay Area headquarters city, and a usable website URL.

output.coordinatePolicy: Bay Area city centroid; no street address inferred

manualCorrections.sourcePolicy: Street addresses and coordinates were added only from the listed official location pages; OMRON uses an OpenStreetMap building coordinate because Census did not match the official address.
